notes.title: Empire in Decay Demo Update 3
notes.notes: [p][u]Savegames from previous versions may not work with this new build![/u][/p][p]Here's a summary of the changes available in the latest update of the demo of Empire in Decay:[/p][list][*][p][b]Fixed bug whereby after crowning a pawn the piece appears with cost 0 in the menus as well[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Knight vs King capture animation[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New planar reflections in several levels[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New water shader in some docks levels[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]In-game HUD redesign to match the one in the menus.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Review of prices and other tweaks for balancing.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New VFX:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Disintegration when dying/being summoned[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bishop diagonal attack[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Armor break/damage[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Backstab VFX[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Rolling saw blades VFX[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Burn, bleed, poison damage[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Empire in Decay Demo Update 2
notes.notes:
[p]Here's a summary of the changes available in the latest update of the demo of Empire in Decay:[/p][list][*][p]Improved control with the gamepad so that the whole game is now playable only with the gamepad (in Steam Deck as well).[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented new tips and tips screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Bleeding and other afflictions happen at the start of the turn.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Bishop textures.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated new weapon for Guild Leader, as well as his respective illustration and card[/p][/*][*][p]Chess FontIcons and Tutorial update.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly improved leader animations and fixed minor issues with them.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new weapon to The Guild leader.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Empire in Decay Demo Update 1
notes.notes: [p]Here's a summary of the changes available in the latest update of the demo of Empire in Decay:[/p][list][*][p]Added a few more tips[/p][/*][*][p]Added Textured Background to some Run Subscreens[/p][/*][*][p]Added information on stuff in cells (Ethereal Flame, Pit Trap, Frozen Cell…)[/p][/*][*][p]Acquire Heirlooms subscreen adjustments and flag redesign for some factions.[/p][/*][*][p]New portraits for most enemy units[/p][/*][*][p]Added options to change the screen resolution and fullscreen mode[/p][/*][*][p]Auto-detect user language the first time they run the game[/p][/*][*][p]Backup system for save files.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug that prevented players to play cards their first game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new tutorial/tip screen[/p][/*][*][p]Extra sounds in the menus[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bugfixes:[/p][list][*][p]Divine Inspiration wasn’t updating the damage multiplier[/p][/*][*][p]Damage multiplier localization bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Text sizes in card panel info is now consistent[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lighting for some characters in some levels[/p][/*][*][p]Added illustration for Drill Exercise[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed AO in Shields. Fixed textures in TrueFlame Pawn[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]
